tool_args.rationale: Acquire the trajectory batch to obtain at least eight observations for identifying the four coupled ODE parameters and the irregular-history memory state.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five trajectories leave genuine parameter-identifiability ambiguity, particularly for the fast memory timescale.
The verified history-conditioned mechanism and irregular prefix already identify the relevant branch; additional trajectories are needed to identify its parameters.
The endpoint-matched history gap and coupled transient lag indicate that discarding memory is not justified.
